data.body:
Goal:
Build the trusted data-only integrator that validates inbox bundles, produces projection-complete generations, and advances canonical control safely.

Verification:
1. Run deterministic pack, full-replay equivalence, vector-race, conflict-ledger, and rollback-generation tests.
2. Run the integrator against concurrent temporary inbox refs and prove exactly one control CAS wins without event loss.
3. Run make sanity.

Constraints:
Treat inbox trees only as untrusted data and never execute their code or workflows. Publish immutable objects first and control last. Retain archives, packs, generations, and unacknowledged tails indefinitely.
data.title: Build the lossless Knots generation integrator
